category: shared seedbox with media stack (French market)

free_tier.stated: 'Essai sous reserve de disponibilite et d'eligibilite. Numero mobile francais (+33) requis.' The conditions block adds: a 48-hour SEED300 trial, 'un seul essai est autorise par compte et par numero'.
free_tier.notes: 48 hours on the 300 Go plan, free, but gated on a French mobile number

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: sold by total storage, 300 Go to 4 To; no single-file cap is published

retention.stated: for the life of the subscription; the trial box is deleted at the end of 48 hours by design

egress.terms: Download is capped per plan: 100 Mbit/s on SEED300, 150 on SEED600, 250 on SEED1000. Upload is stated as '225Go a 630Go/jour' with a link to the upload rules and the warning that 'Des restrictions peuvent s'appliquer, notamment en periode de forte utilisation.' There is no monthly byte figure.
egress.free_allowance: 225-630 GB/day of upload, varying with load

interface_detail: 'Acces FTP(S): Oui'; files can also be pulled from the client-area file explorer. Torrent clients are Transmission, ruTorrent or Flood.
tooling: FTP(S) client or the web file explorer; Jellyfin for streaming; VPN included; no rsync, rclone or API is documented
chaining: A French box whose 100 Mbit/s download cap is the retrieval speed; 100 Mbit/s is 1.08 TB/day theoretical, so the 225-630 GB/day upload rule, not the port, sets the daily ceiling

limits.value: 100 Mbit/s download on SEED300 (150/250 on larger plans)

limits_note: The daily upload range is a fair-use band rather than a hard number; the vendor's own help article is the authority and was not read. The 100 Mbit/s download cap is the retrieval ceiling and is stated plainly.
binding_note: At 1 TiB/month the daily upload band is comfortable (1 TiB/month is 34 GB/day), so on paper nothing binds

identity_cost.detail: The 48-hour trial requires a French mobile number: 'Numero mobile francais (+33) requis', one trial per account and per number. Paid plans need only an account and payment.

reliability_note: Upload speed 'varie selon les horaires et la charge du serveur' with restrictions at peak; the trial is one per account and per phone number.
confidence_note: Plan prices, download caps, the daily upload band, the trial's 48 hours and the +33 requirement are all on the live comparison page read. The upload help article behind the link was not read.

evidence.proved: SEED300 EUR 6.00 TTC/mo for 300 Go at 100 Mbit/s download; SEED600 EUR 9.00 for 600 Go at 150 Mbit/s; SEED1000 EUR 11.00 for 1 To at 250 Mbit/s; upload '225Go a 630Go/jour'; FTP(S) access; 48-hour trial requiring a +33 mobile

the rail list 'PayPal, Credit card (Visa, MasterCard, Visa Electron, Maestro), "Basic" cryptocurrencies (BTC & LTC), Advanced cryptocurrencies (ETH, BCH, DASH, and more than 40 others) from EUR 8, My-Seedbox credit balance (Tokens)' and the Dedipass pricing 'a premium SMS costs you EUR 3.00 and gives you only one credit/Token (worth EUR 1.00). Calls are charged at EUR 1.99'

notes: The trial exists and is free, but a user cannot pass its identity gate without a French mobile, so the usable entry is EUR 6.00 TTC/month for 300 Go. Sustained-rate conversion: 100 Mbit/s = 12.5 MB/s = 1.08 TB/day; 1 TiB/month needs 3.39 Mbit/s, so the cap is generous and the price is the constraint. The first is decisive for the free path, the second for retrieval. A seedbox is a different product from debrid, but it belongs because it is the only host in the sample that prices a cash rail with no card, no bank and no wallet at all. The 3x fee is the answer: that path exists but is the most expensive euro per euro in the corpus.

extras.minimum_term: monthly or annual (-10%), no commitment, manual renewal
extras.apps: Jellyfin, Transmission/ruTorrent/Flood, multi-country VPN, file explorer; Immich and arr stack are not listed for this host
extras.trial_card_required: card or PayPal for paid plans; the trial itself needs a French mobile number
extras.trial_restock: one trial per account and per number; no stock counter published

payment.voucher_detail: Neosurf/SMS/call codes converted to tokens at EUR 1 per token
payment.entry_price: not read; advanced crypto from EUR 8
